title: Slider B pre-collision velocity
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the velocity of slider B just before the first collision using energy conservation, accounting for work done by friction on the horizontal segment.

title: Post-collision velocities
description: Essential: Correctly identifies the velocities of both masses after the elastic collision, showing slider B stops and ball A acquires slider's pre-collision speed.

title: String tension calculation
description: Essential: Correctly applies Newton's second law for circular motion to find the tension in the string immediately after the collision.

title: Minimum speed for circular motion
description: Important: Correctly determines the minimum speed required at the lowest point for the ball to complete vertical circular motion.

title: Slider's total travel distance
description: Important: Correctly applies the work-energy theorem to find the total distance slider B travels before stopping, accounting for friction.

title: Number of complete cycles
description: Important: Correctly relates the slider's travel distance to the fixed spacing to determine the number of times the ball completes circular motion.

title: Energy conservation misuse
description: Pitfall: Fails to account for work done by friction when using energy conservation for slider B's motion.

title: Centripetal force sign error
description: Pitfall: Uses an incorrect force balance (e.g., T + mg = mv²/L) when calculating tension at the lowest point.

title: Condition for circular motion
description: Optional: Explicitly states or derives the condition (v_top ≥ √(gL)) for the ball to complete the vertical circle.
